items.title: Barcola joins Liverpool from PSG in £123m move
items.summary: Liverpool complete the signing of France forward Bradley Barcola from Paris St-Germain for a fee worth up to £123m.

items.title: Man City's £80m move for Gakpo close to collapse
items.summary: Manchester City's proposed £80m move for Liverpool forward Cody Gakpo is close to collapsing.

items.title: Tottenham in talks to sign winger Mudryk on loan
items.summary: Tottenham are in talks to sign Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk on a season-long loan.

items.title: Forest complete £22m Munoz signing from Palace
items.summary: Nottingham Forest complete the £22m signing of Daniel Munoz from Crystal Palace.

items.title: Man City sign Palmeiras winger Allan for £34m
items.summary: Manchester City complete the signing of winger Allan Elias from Palmeiras in a deal worth up to £34.2m.

items.title: Everton make bid for Monaco striker Balogun
items.summary: Everton make an offer for Monaco forward Folarin Balogun - who is valued at £40m by the French club.

items.title: Elliott expected to join Valencia on loan
items.summary: Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott is expected to join Valencia on loan for the rest of the season.

items.title: 'It's not a good relationship, it's a deal for money' - Emery on Villa-Chelsea moves
items.summary: Unai Emery insists that there are no "good relations" between Chelsea and Aston Villa after a series of transfers between the clubs.

items.title: Newcastle close in on £55m deal for Fernandez-Pardo
items.summary: Newcastle United are closing in on the signing of Lille forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo in a deal worth up to £55m.

items.title: Everton forced to move EFL Cup tie at short notice
items.summary: Everton are forced to move their Carabao Cup third-round match against Championship side Wolves - nine days before it was due to be played.

items.title: Man Utd near deal for Mexico's Bernal
items.summary: Manchester United are close to signing Mexico international Rebeca Bernal from Washington Spirit.

items.title: Barcola - the 'grasshopper' who has overcome setbacks
items.summary: As Liverpool complete a £123m transfer for Bradley Barcola, BBC Sport looks at how he has ridden triumphs and setbacks to reach the top with the help of his family.

items.title: Watkins completes £51m move to Saudi side Al-Hilal
items.summary: Ollie Watkins says he never imagined or intended his Aston Villa career to "end this way" after completing his £51m move to Al-Hilal.

items.title: Tottenham enquire about Pulisic - Monday's gossip
items.summary: Spurs turn attention to Christian Pulisic, Liverpool and Everton show interest in Stuttgart winger Jamie Leweling, and Crystal Palace want to keep Dean Henderson after Nottingham Forest bid.

items.title: Germany's Wamser completes move to Man City
items.summary: Manchester City complete the signing of Bayer Leverkusen and Germany defender Carlotta Wamser on a four-year deal.

items.title: Swansea agree loan of Manchester City's Monga
items.summary: Manchester City winger Jeremy Monga is set for a season at Swansea City, who will allow Finland international Leo Walta to join Los Angeles on loan.

items.title: Tottenham make Ndiaye move with Richarlison set for Everton
items.summary: Tottenham are in advanced talks to sign Iliman Ndiaye from Everton, with Richarlison set to move in the opposite direction as part of separate negotiations.

items.title: Barcelona close to deal for Arsenal's Jesus
items.summary: Barcelona are closing in on a move for Arsenal striker Gabriel Jesus in a deal worth £8.6m.

items.title: Everton call off Armstrong sale after fan backlash
items.summary: Everton have called off a proposed deal to sell midfielder Harrison Armstrong to Nottingham Forest following a backlash from the club's supporters.

items.title: Man Utd sign Swedish winger Jusu Bah for £400K
items.summary: Manchester United have confirmed the signing of Sweden winger Monica Jusu Bah from BK Hacken for just under £400,000.

items.title: Man City agree £65m Ndiaye deal, Spurs turn attention to Mudryk
items.summary: Manchester City have agreed a £65m deal with Everton for winger Iliman Ndiaye as an alternative to Cody Gakpo.

Man City open talks with Chelsea to sign Fernandez
items.summary: Manchester City have opened direct club-to-club talks with Chelsea to sign Enzo Fernandez, according to Sky in Italy.

items.summary: Newcastle United are closing in on a deal to sign Matias Fernandez-Pardo.
